title: Report: GTA 6 'Checking Out' Mission Walkthrough Details Chapter 2 Point of No Return
description: VideoGamesChronicle publishes a step-by-step guide for the final mission of Chapter 2, highlighting irreversible story progression and combat strategies.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Checking Out Walkthrough: Chapter 2 Point of No Return Explained
socialHook: VideoGamesChronicle releases a walkthrough for GTA 6's Chapter 2 finale mission 'Checking Out', detailing the point of no return.

sections.heading: Mission Overview and Point of No Return Warning
paragraphs: VideoGamesChronicle has published a walkthrough for 'Checking Out,' the thirty-fifth mission in Grand Theft Auto 6 and the final mission of Chapter 2. The guide emphasizes that once the mission begins, players cannot back out, and the events permanently remove the Starlet Motel as a safehouse. VGC advises making a manual save before starting, noting that returning to the motel later in the story is also worthwhile.

sections.heading: Combat Walkthrough and Key Objectives
paragraphs: The walkthrough describes the opening cutscene where armed attackers surround the Starlet Motel. Gameplay begins with Jason fighting out of the motel room; VGC recommends picking up the shotgun on the bed before exiting. Outside, players should use cover to eliminate enemies in the parking area and collect ammo from fallen foes. The objective then shifts to crossing the motel grounds to the café to regroup with Lucia.

sections.heading: Spoiler Notice and Guide Context
paragraphs: This guide contains story spoilers for Chapter 2's conclusion. VideoGamesChronicle presents the walkthrough as part of its GTA 6 Guide Hub, which includes beginner tips, navigation explanations, and cheat codes. The publication does not disclose any additional secrets or alternate outcomes for the mission beyond the described linear progression.
